response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench

assumptions.assumption: A missing risk evaluation status means riskeval IS NULL. GROUP BY puts all NULLs in a single group, and empty strings are not treated as missing.
A group whose total spanmin is 0 or NULL has no defined rate (NULLIF avoids division by zero). It is ignored in the benchmark average and cannot count as above the benchmark.
If no group is above the benchmark, the query still returns one row with NULL in both columns.
